The supplied filing facts do not establish ANET country revenue, supply-chain, policy exposure, or an asset-specific political transmission mechanism. No geopolitical directional view is supported.

ANET has a constructive long-term price trend and strong reported profitability, but intermediate momentum is mixed and macro transmission is unverified. The evidence supports conditional technical views, not a calibrated return forecast.

The supplied QQQ holdings table identifies constituents but has no sector or country allocation, and no sourced policy-to-holdings transmission mechanism. A geopolitical directional view is unsupported.

QQQ's short-term daily trend is weak while its 200-session trend remains positive. Current holdings and sponsor metrics establish concentration and valuation context, but news and macro evidence are conflicting and not return-attributed.
